title: On-Demand Delivery Platforms and Restaurant Sales
eligible_reason: Replication-stage verification (data/replication_logs/mnsc.2021.01010.md): county-by-week mobility control in every regression
design_notes: Panel of 14,036 Chicago-area restaurants (zip prefixes 600-608, 462-463) by week, 53 weeks starting 2018-12-31 through 2019-12-30 (603,244 obs, unbalanced: median 50 weeks per restaurant, 2,874 restaurants enter after week 1). Treatment onplatform_weekly = 1 once the restaurant has joined a delivery platform; never switches off. 10,107 restaurants never treated; 3,929 ever treated, of which 2,908 are already treated at first observation (always-treated, 2,407 of them at week 1) and 1,021 are within-sample switchers spread over 52 distinct weeks. Matched subsample (matched==1): 2,964 restaurants (126,810 obs), 1,991 never treated, 969 switchers over 49 distinct weeks, 4 always-treated. Outcomes log1p(takeout_visits) and log1p(dinein_visits). FE: restaurant (rest_numericID) and week-of-year (Week_Num); clustering by restaurant; no weights. Table 5 and Table 7 add onplatform_weekly:brand_ornot (chain subgroup-by-treatment interaction, excluded). Table 6 uses proprietary Visa data and Table 8-9 use proprietary Grubhub data with xtivreg2 IV (excluded, data not shared). Full-text flags show the paper cites Callaway-Sant'Anna, Sun-Abraham, Goodman-Bacon and Baker-Larcker-Wang, so a modern-estimator robustness check likely exists in the article/appendix, but no such code is in the package.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 52 distinct switch-on weeks among within-sample switchers (full sample); 49 in the matched subsample. Counting always-treated units as cohorts gives 53.
data_files: fooddeliver.dta (Stata, 603,244 x 15, restaurant-week panel for Tables 3-5)
software_notes: R (lfe::felm, haven, data.table, stargazer); Tables 6, 8, 9 are Stata commands on unshared proprietary Visa/Grubhub data.
priority_note: 3 under the strict protocol (no spec without time-varying controls). Would be priority 1 if the lead allows dropping the single mobility control: data, code and 52 adoption cohorts with a large never-treated pool are all present.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Readme lists 15 variables; data confirmed. Treatment never switches off. Always-treated restaurants (2,908 in full sample, 4 in matched) would be dropped or handled per Hull Appendix B. Week_Num is week-of-year within a single calendar year, so it coincides with calendar time. Clustering at restaurant level; no weights. Cannot verify from the package whether the published paper reports CSA/Sun-Abraham estimates, though citation flags suggest a robustness discussion exists.
